name: Demetrius of Bithynia
bio: Demetrius of Bithynia is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 2nd century BC (with a query).
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 730).

poems.title: Book IX, 730
poems.author: Demetrius of Bithynia
poems.text: If a calf sees me, it will low; a bull will mount me, and the herdsman drive me to the herd.
